findings.title: Payment method type fragmentation & duplicate schemas
findings.description: packages/shared/src/index.ts had duplicate copy-paste definitions of paymentMethodSchema and paymentStatusSchema, while UI components used ad-hoc switch cases ('deposit' vs 'family_wallet', 'sbp' vs 'online').
findings.resolution: Exported canonical SSOT converters normalizePaymentMethod, resolveFfd12PaymentTag, STATUTORY_PAYMENT_METHOD_LABELS_RU, and extendedPaymentMethodSchema from packages/shared/src/fiscal/fiscalReceiptSchemas.ts.

findings.title: Float math and Math.round(/100) penny loss in split checkout and offline queue
findings.description: PaymentCapture.tsx, fastCheckoutEngine.ts, and offlinePaymentQueue.ts performed raw Math.round(x / 100) and float addition, losing fractional kopecks on multi-tender splits and offline billing.
findings.resolution: Replaced with exact rubToKopecks, kopecksToRub, and kopecksToNumericString from @dental/shared, ensuring zero penny loss.

findings.title: Broken doctor payout debt explanation assertion
findings.description: Commit 99c07d261 accidentally suppressed the negative payout debt note in payoutRowNote, causing apps/api/src/services/finance/payoutNegativeExplain.test.ts to fail.
findings.resolution: Restored both payoutRub < 0 (debt note) and payoutRub === 0 (Labor Code RF minimum zero note) branches in doctorPayouts.ts.

findings.title: Test suite coupling to UI CSS in stagePayment.test.ts
